company.name: MicroHealth
company.shortDescription: MicroHealth is a clinical-grade digital health company helping patients and healthcare professionals succeed in hemophilia treatment.
company.description:
MicroHealth empowers people with chronic conditions to live healthier lives and healthcare professionals to improve clinical outcomes by leveraging mobile technology and a social health network.

Their mission is to shape the future of chronic care management by engaging patients, triggering positive behavior change, and connecting all care participants to make better health decisions.
